$comment: Module registry. Single source of truth for which modules the repo offers. A module bundles agents + commands + skills delivering a capability. The core module is host- and language-agnostic; adapter modules carry language/tool specifics and are optional. Order = display order. Schema per module: code, name, description, default_selected, source, agents[], commands[], skills[].

modules.name: Coder Squad Core
modules.description: Autonomous, self-improving, language-agnostic coder-agent squad: a governance router (AGENTS.md), a four-role squad (orchestrator/worker/validator/discover), six phase commands, and the core skills that drive the think-act-prove-grow loop.

modules.name: Go Language Adapter
modules.description: Go-specific coding doctrine (errors, naming, concurrency, context, performance). Optional domain adapter.

modules.name: OpenAPI Adapter
modules.description: OpenAPI 3.2 spec generation, repair, and validation. Optional domain adapter backing command/openapi.

modules.name: Confluence Adapter
modules.description: Atlassian Confluence operations via the mcp-atlassian bridge. Optional domain adapter.
